acceptance.failure: Any outgoing command without an observed visual terminal view, any connection without verified distributed correspondence, or either visual anchor return above 3 px ends the route. A dispatched action is never retried. If an outgoing command may have reached the camera before a terminal view is observed, one remaining bounded AbsoluteMove is used only as the predeclared safety return.
acceptance.success: The same run records a quiet baseline, verified baseline-to-pan, baseline-to-tilt and tilt-to-pan connections, then ends at the baseline within 3 px after each bounded anchor return. Every terminal view follows observed visual departure rather than only a fixed grace delay.

hypothesis: E9P2 accepted a pre-motion quiet window because tilt video motion can appear several seconds after a finite command. Requiring observed visual departure plus a quiet terminal window before each next route action can produce the two-band graph and a visually verified return in one bounded execution.
